contracts: (After restart, the Attempt reaches a bounded reconciled state with evidence of no chat or old-process dependency.) AND (Targeted RestoreBoundaryTests discovers and passes the explicit-request case with nonzero count, then full suite passes.) AND (The exact selector executes with nonzero discovery and verifies one authorized creation plus denied unprotected attempts.) AND (The exact selector passes with a nonzero discovered test count and durable evidence shows one operation identifier for both submissions.) AND (The response-state selector executes with nonzero discovery and validates the bounded state assertion.) AND (The targeted Run-completion selector is discovered and verifies zero Restore starts.) AND (The targeted test is discovered and verifies reconciliation evidence sourced from durable Attempt/staging state without chat or terminated-process dependency.) AND (任何 stale/missing authority 均使操作 blocked，且无后续 readback/Run 副作用。) AND (操作读回可验证状态与失败类别，且公共响应不含原始异常或敏感细节。) AND (终止时必须有八个 authority 与当前 blocker 的当前证据；否则结果为 blocked。)
selector_intents: PhaseA.Platform.Tests.PhaseB.SnapshotTests.RunCompletionDoesNotStartRestore observes that Run completion does not enqueue or start Restore without an explicit request.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests fails when any operation response omits state or returns a value outside the bounded set.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests kills the restore process after verification, restarts the host, and checks reconciliation from durable Attempt/staging state.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies the explicit authorized Restore selector observes a started operation; fail when Restore remains unstarted or starts from a non-explicit trigger.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.ProtectedRestoreRequest_RequiresExplicitAuthorizedEntry observes operation creation from an implicit or unprotected invocation.
RestoreBoundaryTests 检测到响应缺少失败类别或受限状态，或泄露原始异常时应失败。
验证 validity gate 在任一 authority stale/missing 时返回 blocked，并阻止后续 readback 与 controlled Run。
验证恢复检查在缺失任一 authority 或仅提供历史摘要而无当前 blocker 时阻断。
